18.name: Take a Bow
18.overview: Blacksmith Kev faces his biggest ever challenge: theatre lighting stands. But will his risky redesign steal the show?

18.name: A Concrete Plan?
18.overview: Pine, a traffic cone and cement... it is a bonkers design and Ollie's hoping for cool tables - but will Jacqui be shocked?

18.name: In Pole Position!
18.overview: A bucket of old toys has designer Rupert all revved up, but is his plan veering right off the road?

18.name: Spike's Old Chairs
18.overview: Three old chairs bring tears to the eyes, and Jacqui's imagination is on fire as she wrestles an old plant stand.

18.name: Right Tools for the Job
18.overview: A huge profit! Huge, but from which item? Kev creates a metal masterpiece from obsolete tools, while JJ tries to double the charm of two rattan chairs.

18.name: Kneading a Profit
18.overview: And relax... but Jacqui Joseph isn't feeling zen when it comes to saving a massage bed. Sarah Peterson might need a lie-down too, trying to save a tricky dining set.

18.name: Curveballs and Waves
18.overview: Are creative curves good for us? Katie and Sophie attempt a wavy redesign that leaves them feeling seasick.

18.name: Boiling Point!
18.overview: Kev's in hot water! Boiling, in fact, as he wrestles a rusty water tank. Jacqui tries to make a massive display unit fit for a modern home.

18.name: A Lot on Your Plate?
18.overview: Are old plates valuable? It's a smashing skip find for Sarah Moore, while carpenter Ollie tries to launder a tidy profit from an old washstand.

18.name: The Right Wavelength
18.overview: 'Broadsword calling Duncan. Come in with a plan. Over!' Duncan has a retro radio to save, and can newbie Tyler rescue a sewing machine table?

18.name: You Spin Me Round!
18.overview: Like a record, baby! JJ gets the oven fired up, trying to repurpose a record collection into something new.

18.name: Make It Rain Cash
18.overview: With three items saved from Witley recycling centre in Surrey, upcycling expert Sarah Moore gets to work trying to turn trash into cash. For her own project, Sarah tries to make the sun shine a profit on a garden umbrella. and a pair of tired 70s armchairs puts upholsterer Larissa through her paces.

18.name: Unleash the Bookcase Beast!
18.overview: A 'beast' of a bookcase poses a huge challenge for carpenter Sam, and Jacqui Joseph goes wild with patchwork.

18.name: Bounce Back
18.overview: Bag maker Neil jumps at the chance to save an inflatable castle, but will working with the tricky material leaved him deflated?

18.name: Footing the Bill
18.overview: Salvage expert Guy has an out-there plan for some old shoe lasts, while Sarah Moore hangs her hopes on making cash from puncturing copper.

18.name: Woman with a Golden Gun - Not!
18.overview: Quick, change the plan! Will a disaster with a rug gun leave Sarah's chances of saving a 100-year-old rug in tatters?

18.name: Ready to Rock!
18.overview: A mysterious wooden post turns up at the tip, and Jacqui Joseph tries to get a dated rocking chair back in full swing.

18.name: Worth the Candle?
18.overview: Sarah Moore risks getting her fingers burnt creating candlesticks from old spindles, and a last-minute change of plan by Simion throws the cat among the creative pigeons.

18.name: It's Just Not Croquet!
18.overview: Saving old lawn bowls and a croquet set is far from fun and games for Guy, while upcyclers Katie and Sophie get brown furniture but need some bright ideas.

18.name: The Worm Has Turned... Wood into Dust
18.overview: A woodworm-infested chair frame leaves husband-and-wife team Dani and Elliot with a huge job on their hands.

19.name: Pull Out All the Stops
19.overview: Expert upcycler Sarah Moore calls on woodworking legend Norman Wilkinson for his biggest ever challenge... a smashed-up organ.

19.name: New Heights
19.overview: New York's calling... Sarah Peterson channels Manhattan's skyline with a skyscraper-inspired new look, and Jacqui Joseph hopes buyers will shell out for upcycled seashells. Meanwhile, designer-maker Ollie tries to get a broken bench back in action. Will all three upcycling projects be a success?

19.name: Fore!
19.overview: Salvage expert Guy has a flush of inspiration with a loo-roll-inspired idea for wooden golf clubs, but he can't stop there... and the ideas just keep coming!

19.name: Guitar Solo
19.overview: Young Jacob's got an extraordinary idea for a guitar-themed table. It's his first 'solo' project, but will Jacqui Joseph be asking for an encore?

19.name: Out of This World!
19.overview: Blast off! Retro chairs meet galactic glamour as Sarah Peterson shoots for the stars with a cosmic revamp, but will this project soar or be lost in space?

19.name: Comfort Zone
19.overview: Don't throw out the good with the bad. It's a tricky one for Larissa as she tries to turn a comfy, much-loved sofa into something cool.

19.name: Beans! Beans! Good for the Art?
19.overview: Beans?! New presenter Rob Bent is stunned by Rupert's risky plan to save a kitchen unit with baked-bean tins.

19.name: Hiding to Nothing?
19.overview: When Jacqui finds leather hides, she thinks that 'high end' is the only way to go and that Uzo is the only man for the job.

19.name: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall...
19.overview: Who can write the catchiest slogan of them all? Sarah Moore turns to sardines for inspiration, while Bruce goes for a pink rethink on some kitchen units.

19.name: Wardrobe Malfunction?
19.overview: In Buckinghamshire, Jacqui Joseph explores High Wycombe Recycling Centre, determined to save quality items from being crushed. It's a high-stakes first for Simion, upholstering a wardrobe, while Jacqui retunes a TV unit for the modern market. But will it get a good reception?

19.name: Mental Block
19.overview: Sarah Moore has got bedsheets, block-printing dreams and scissors, but in this game, you need to know when to change the plan.

19.name: Chair Rescue
19.overview: Jacqui Joseph is at High Wycombe Recycling Centre in Buckinghamshire, with an eagle eye, hoping to swoop in on quality items before they are lost for ever. Upholsterer Ollie takes radical action by knocking off 'ears', and Hannah turns to flower power for a sewing box in need of some TLC.
